title: Bengaluru's MTR Keeps Its MICHELIN Bib Gourmand in Kuala Lumpur for 2027
excerpt: MTR 1924 Malaysia, the Brickfields outlet of Bengaluru's 102-year-old Mavalli Tiffin Rooms, is listed again as a Bib Gourmand in the MICHELIN Guide Kuala Lumpur & Penang 2027, the guide's fifth edition covering 159 establishments.
body:
• MTR 1924 Malaysia in Brickfields, Kuala Lumpur, is listed as a Bib Gourmand — MICHELIN's distinction for good-quality cooking at great value — in the MICHELIN Guide Kuala Lumpur & Penang 2027.
  • It is a retention, not a first award: the outlet has held the Bib Gourmand in the 2025 and 2026 guides as well.
  • The restaurant is the Malaysian branch of Mavalli Tiffin Rooms, founded in Bengaluru in 1924, making the brand 102 years old in 2026; the Kuala Lumpur outlet has operated since 2017.
  • If you go: MTR 1924 Malaysia is at 69 Jalan Thambipillay, Brickfields, Kuala Lumpur, listed as open 8:00 a.m. to 10:30 p.m. and on public holidays.

A 102-year-old Bengaluru institution has kept its place in the MICHELIN Guide. MTR Malaysia, the international branch of Mavalli Tiffin Rooms, has been named a MICHELIN Bib Gourmand 2027, Curly Tales reported on November 7. The recognition highlights the branch's hospitality and its authentic South Indian vegetarian food, which it serves to hundreds of diners.

What the 2027 guide says

The MICHELIN Guide Kuala Lumpur & Penang 2027, unveiled on November 4, is the guide's fifth edition for Malaysia and features 159 establishments across the two cities: one two-star restaurant, nine one-star restaurants, 60 Bib Gourmand and 89 MICHELIN Selected establishments, according to the guide's announcement. In the Kuala Lumpur Bib Gourmand list, MTR 1924 appears under Indian Vegetarian cuisine, one of 26 Bib Gourmand holders in the capital. Four establishments earned the Bib Gourmand for the first time this year; MTR 1924 was not among the newcomers — it held the distinction in 2025 and 2026 and has retained it for 2027, the guide's full selection shows.

Unlike MICHELIN Stars, which recognise exceptional cooking, the Bib Gourmand spotlights high-quality food served at a reasonable price — the guide's own description is "good quality, good value cooking."

"A 102-year-old Bengaluru institution has kept its place in the MICHELIN Guide."

A Bengaluru name in Brickfields

Founded in 1924, Mavalli Tiffin Rooms began its journey in Bengaluru and now has branches in many countries, including Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Australia. The Kuala Lumpur restaurant operates as MTR 1924 Malaysia in Brickfields, the neighbourhood also known as Little India, and has been a popular dining spot among locals since 2017, according to its MICHELIN Guide description. Its menu is South Indian vegetarian food served in the tiffin-room format the Bengaluru original is known for.

Planning a visit

MTR 1924 Malaysia is at 69 Jalan Thambipillay, Brickfields, 50470 Kuala Lumpur. Its listings give operating hours of 8:00 a.m. to 10:30 p.m., open on all public holidays. For diaspora readers in Malaysia, it is one of the few Indian vegetarian restaurants in the capital carrying a MICHELIN distinction; for visitors from India, it is a familiar Bengaluru name — the same Mavalli Tiffin Rooms founded a century ago — cooking in Kuala Lumpur's Little India.
